card.name: The word risk in opioid breathing warning
card.fires_on: The word "risk" right after "the" in the opioid warning sentence "respiratory depression can occur at any time during the use of [drug], the risk is greatest during initiation". One odd case is a comma after a legal case citation.

modes.label: Opioid warning sentence
modes.description: "risk" follows "the" after a drug name, just before "is greatest during the initiation of therapy".
modes.example: the sedating effects of opioids. While serious, life-threatening or fatal respiratory depression can occur at any time during the use of BELBUCA, the<< risk>> is greatest during initiation of therapy or following

modes.label: Legal citation comma
modes.description: A comma after a California case volume and page number, before the pinpoint page.
modes.example: the state over its members and whatever belongs to them. Gilmer v. Lime Point, 18 Cal. 229<<,>> 250 (S.Ct.
